svg.title: HealthOS — Compose infrastructure
svg.desc: Docker Compose network with frontend port 3000, Core, Celery, AI and notification. PostgreSQL, Redis and MinIO use named volumes. MinIO init and Alembic migration are one-shot. Dashed edges mean readiness/init dependencies, not notification HTTP calls.
svg.text: Services, persistent data and startup conditions in the production configuration.
Solid: HTTP / data. Dashed: readiness or init gate; secondary dependencies are omitted.
Configured, not runtime-validated. No beat service declared; no web CI/CD claim.
